st: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Peter Fonda (1/4/85)
d: Actor/screenwriter Peter Fonda opens up about being compared to his father and sister. Charles Nelson Reilly recalls his dad pouring cheap bourbon into fancy bottles to hide their poverty.

st: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '80s - Ed Begley, Jr. (9/28/84)
d: Ed Begley Jr. returns and is joined by Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom's Kate Capshaw and comedian Bobby Kelton.

st: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Lilly Tomlin (2/20/75)
d: Lily Tomlin describes her Detroit childhood, creating a character by working a check-out counter and her career as a shoplifter.

st: The Johnny Carson Show: Animal Antics With Joan Embery (1/1/75)
d: Celebrate New Year’s day with Foster Brooks, Victor Buono, and…..Joan Embery and her gorilla friends.

st: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Garry Shandling (5/8/92)
d: Garry claims that he bombed during his previous appearance so this time he delivers the goods, covering everything from Sonny Bono to Captain & Tenille.

st: Hollywood Icons Of The '50s - Jimmy Stewart (12/27/89)
d: Oscar winner Jimmy Stewart describes an evening at the celebrity-fave nightclub when teenager Judy Garland showed up and sang for the gang.

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S7 E18 - Joel Grey, Vincent Price
d: Life is a cabaret when Joel Grey and Vincent Price are guest starring! The two play guests at a hotel where Carol is the switchboard operator (who listens in on all the calls.) Also: "Carol & Sis."

st: The Johnny Carson Show: Hollywood Icons Of The '70s - Sylvester Stallone (5/21/82)
d: Rocky star Sylvester Stallone brings his son Sage to meet Johnny. Describes getting kicked out of several schools, and chats about stardom with fellow guest Steve Martin.

st: Groovy Sounds
d: Ed Sullivan presents performances by The Young Rascals, The Turtles, Spanky & Our Gang, The 5th Dimension, Oliver, and The Beach Boys.

st: The Best Of Richard Pryor (1/12/79)
d: Was Richard Pryor’s grandmother really a tyrant?  Hear Pryor’s recollections of grandma battle-ax.  Comic genius Tim Conway remembers his early days in Vegas.

st: Comic Legends Of The '90s - Bob Saget (5/5/89)
d: Full House dad Bob Saget explains his attempts at trying to improve his appearance.  He also comments on the various people he meets at his gym.

t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
st: Family Show
d: This 'Family Show' features Dick as an airport traveler getting a long, awkward farewell from his family

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S11 E14 - Steve Lawrence
d: Guest star Steve Lawrence takes on a villainous role in a WWII spy spoof, and Carol multitasks,  singing "You Light Up My Life" while bathing Tim.

t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
st: Gloria Swanson
d: Guest Gloria Swanson arrives for the Q&A but she only has eyes for Lyle. Sketches include a 'Carol & Sis'

t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
st: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show Ep. 114
d: Ed Sullivan presents Eddie Fisher, Lilly Yokoi, GaliGali, Polly Bergen, Tokyo Olympiad, and Eddie Fisher.

st: Comic Legends Of The '70s - Carol Burnett (8/10/79)
d: Carol Burnett reveals her Hollywood idols, Tim Conway details losing his car at a party and Johnny discusses The Joy Of Sex. Plus, Robert Easton and Tracee Talavera appear.

st: The Carol Burnett Show: S6 E13 - Bernadette Peters, Anthony Newley
d: Stars of stage and screen Anthony Newley and Bernadette Peters guest. This episode features Carol as The Invisible Man's mother, and Anthony as a man who can get anything thanks to his British accent.

st: The Johnny Carson Show: The Best Of Garry Shandling (12/7/82)
d: Garry is joined by Jimmy Stewart on this episode, who talks about working with Carol Burnett Bette Davis and others.

st: Comic Legends Of The '70s - George Carlin (8/21/85)
d: A stand-up routine by comic giant George Carlin highlights this episode which also features record-setting test pilot Chuck Yeager.

st: The Johnny Carson Show: Comic Legends Of The '80s - Steven Wright (12/12/84)
d: The king of dry humor, Steven Wright talks about everything from his girlfriend to filming a small part in his first movie.
